cover.headline: What Australia's betting ban covers.
cover.deal: The new rules for sport, from kit to broadcasts

rows.sub: No betting ads on uniforms or at venues
Betting ads banned around live events
On-field, stadium and coaches' box signs
Races are not treated as sporting events
Trade reports say existing deals can run on
A statutory review is built in
Every AFL and NRL club has one, FARE found
The first clubs to leave will set the price

caption:
Australia's betting ad ban starts 1 January 2027, and sport is right in the firing line.

Betting brands can no longer advertise on playing kit or around grounds, and live sport broadcasts get a betting ad blackout from 15 minutes before the start to 5 minutes after the finish. Racing is carved out, and trade reports say existing deals can run until the end of 2031. The big question is who fills the space.
